name: Flat hot dog
summary: Flat hot dog in a long bun with sausage, mustard zig-zag and ketchup. For street food, snack or ballpark scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the hot dog rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~400 px wide); use about 0.2 to 0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = rock on its base, pop = scale in
